review_scope: Independent metadata parser boundary/typing/ZIP handling review; no model inference or graph reconstruction validation.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial auto detection preferred legacy when offset16 equaled total size, even when Bach size-at-offset0 also matched.
resolved_findings.resolution: Now returns kind=ambiguous/status=not_decoded/candidate_kinds and CLI exit 2; explicit kind remains required to interpret ambiguous inputs.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent crafted file validates explicitly as Bach, is ambiguous in auto, and exits 2 via CLI.

coverage: Bach total/group/info sizes and counts, bounded NUL names, payload overflow, trailing bytes
Native XOR8 group payload checksum with enabled/disabled flag distinction
Type0 bounded ASCII parameter text, signed int32 and float32 exact sizes; unknown/noncanonical/nonfinite/Unicode values remain opaque
Expected SHA-256 mismatch and uppercase digest input
Legacy and BM header-only contracts without tensor/weight claims
ZIP exact named read, missing/duplicate/directory/encrypted member rejection, tampered stored payload CRC rejection
CLI machine-readable rejection/unknown/ambiguous statuses and exit codes
1000 deterministic byte-mutation trials: bounded parse or FormatError, never leaked IndexError/struct.error/nonfinite JSON
Both actual downloaded model files classified without copying or modifying payloads

native_cross_check.checked: file size at0, groupCount at36, size table at40, first group offset40+4*count
checksum enable file[4], XOR from group+292 to group end, stored byte group+256
292 group header, parameter table before entries, 296 parameter header, payloadLen at292 and payload at296

native_cross_check.note: Inspector intentionally enforces stronger span/count/name limits than native strcmp/memcpy. Passing inspection establishes this metadata layout only.

limitations: Legacy tt_goodlike remains header-identified with opaque payload; no decryption or inference claim.
Bach graph/data payloads remain hashed opaque buffers; scalar metadata is not tensor dtype or network precision proof.
Bach zero-parameter group is describable metadata; native group lookup returns no usable group for that case, and inspector makes no usability claim.
ZIP member decompression and standalone reads are capped at128 MiB; this is not a general adversarial ZIP-library audit.
scope_note: Independent review of earlier source revision: Bach + legacy/BM header recognition only. New legacy envelope parser is covered by current host tests and 39 builtin fixtures, not this independent review.
